WHY HELLO! YOU ARE NOT SUPPOSED TO SEE THIS!
The currency of hell has it's value and is sought after by many for it's most curious effects, this poor devil will happily trade their merchandise in exchange for these coins.
Quarters use different currencies to construct, but all require Engine Parts which can be obtained by trading with merchants found, you may even scavenge them if you are lucky.
Sanctuary Square was once a beacon of hope, it has since fallen in ruin constructing these machines will allow us to shake off the shackles of Retinue.

Before the Retinue gained complete dominance of lands, this town was in the process of revolutionising it's industry. Now the parts needed have been confiscated and hidden find them and find a way to enter the new age.
